name: workbuddy
label: WorkBuddy
query: SELECT id, cwd, COALESCE(NULLIF(custom_title,''), title, '') AS title, status, COALESCE(is_background_automation, 0) AS bg FROM sessions WHERE last_activity_at > ? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT (COALESCE(is_background_automation, 0) = 1 AND status != 'error') ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC LIMIT 60
